title: Household Appliances
painPoint: Household appliance manufacturers face intense pressure to improve motor efficiency while reducing size, weight, and cost. Washing machines, refrigerator compressors, air conditioner fan motors, and robotic vacuum cleaners all demand compact NdFeB magnets with high magnetic flux density. However, operating environments vary drastically: refrigerator compressor motors run continuously at elevated temperatures requiring 42SH or 38SH grade magnets with excellent coercivity retention, while vacuum cleaner motors spin at over 100,000 RPM, demanding N52 and N50SH grades that resist demagnetization under extreme centrifugal stress. Inconsistent magnetic properties across batches lead to motor vibration, noise, and premature failure, eroding brand reputation and increasing warranty costs.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU delivers precision-engineered NdFeB magnets tailored for household appliance motor applications, with magnetic flux uniformity controlled within plus or minus 2 percent across production batches. Our 42SH and 38SH grades maintain stable magnetic performance in continuous-duty compressor motors up to 150 degrees Celsius, while high-energy N52 magnets provide maximum torque density for compact fan and pump motors. We apply optimized multi-layer NiCuNi and epoxy coatings to withstand humid, corrosive operating environments common in washing machines and dishwashers. Every magnet undergoes flux-gated inspection and demagnetization curve testing before shipment.
